checks.name: A1-existing-tests-unchanged
checks.summary: Measured at HEAD 576019e: internal/release had 3 top-level tests (TestCompileFoundationBaselineContract, TestBundleImmutableRouteAndRollback, TestContractAndPromotionGateRejectDriftAndStaleEvidence) and internal/contracts had 14. After this task: the same 3 and the same 14 tests exist under the same names, with unedited bodies, and pass. internal/release additionally has 33 new top-level test functions (36 total) covering A2-A20; no existing test body was rewritten, renamed or re-proven.

checks.name: A2-docs-drift-defect-regression
checks.summary: TestPipelinePromoteRefusesFabricatedMatchingDocsDigest pins the measured defect: before, PromotionGate alone promotes a candidate whose DocsDigest and every evidence[i].DocsDigest are both set to the fabricated string set here to the same value, with a nil error, because it only compares the candidate against its own evidence. After: Pipeline.Promote (VerifySource + VerifyCandidateDigests + VerifyCandidateAgainstContract + PromotionGate) refuses the same candidate because VerifyCandidateDigests recomputes DocsDigest from the bundle's source-derived Members and finds it disagrees with the fabricated value.

checks.name: A3-bundle-manifest-and-digest-framing
checks.summary: TestBundleAssemblyIsDeterministicAndOrderIndependent: two assemblies of the same synthetic tree produce byte-identical BundleDigest/DocsDigest/ContractDigest, a shuffled member order produces the same BundleDigest, and CompiledContract.DocsDigest equals the doc-set digest by construction. TestBundleAssemblyRefusesSymlinkMember, TestBundleAssemblyRefusesMissingDeclaredMember, TestBundleAssemblyRefusesRoleWithZeroMembers and TestMemberPathEscapingRootIsRefused cover the four refusal cases (symlink, missing declared member, zero-member role, path escaping the root). CompileContract's signature is unchanged.

checks.name: A4-evidence-key-closure-and-unguarded-allowlist
checks.summary: TestReleaseEvidenceKeyClosureAndUnguardedAllowlist parses ci/components.json directly (no import of internal/ci) and recomputes the release component's evidence-key closure: internal/release/**, contracts/** (via the contracts dependency) and ci/components.json, go.mod, go.sum, devbox.lock. Every real-tree bundle member is asserted to be either inside that closure (contract, schema, api-contract, implementation-manifest roles) or named in the UnguardedMembers allowlist (migration, configuration, documentation roles) with a reason; an allowlisted glob that is covered by the closure fails the test.

checks.name: A5-docs-drift-gate-hermetic-with-negative-control
checks.summary: In a t.TempDir() synthetic tree: promote a fully-evidenced candidate to stable, flip one byte of one documentation member, and assert (a) DocsDigest changed, (b) VerifySource refuses naming docs/preview/index.md, (c) the pre-edit evidence no longer satisfies CanPromote once bound to the post-edit digest, (d) Pipeline.Promote errors and Router.Generation is unchanged, and (e) the mandatory negative control: flipping a byte in a file matching no role glob (NOTES.txt) leaves BundleDigest and DocsDigest unchanged. Without (e) a whole-tree hash would satisfy (a)-(d) too and make every unrelated commit a docs drift.

checks.name: A6-evidence-freshness-per-role-with-negative-control
checks.summary: TestEvidenceFreshnessInvalidatesPerRole runs one subtest per role (contract, schema, api-contract, implementation-manifest, migration, configuration, documentation): mutating that role's member changes BundleDigest, and evidence recorded against the pre-mutation BundleDigest fails CanPromote against the post-mutation candidate. Invalidation is read from the digest comparison, not from a boolean the test sets. TestEvidenceFreshnessNegativeControlUnrelatedFileInvalidatesNothing asserts a file matching no role leaves both digests unchanged and evidence remains valid.

checks.name: A7-capability-set-derived-from-contract
checks.summary: AssembleCandidate derives ReleaseCandidate.Capabilities from CompiledContract.Capabilities in contract order. TestRealTreeFoundationCandidateIsNotPromotable asserts the real-tree Foundation candidate declares exactly the twelve baseline ids in order. TestEvidenceFreshnessInvalidatesPerRole's harness exercises the eleven-of-twelve case via domain.CanPromote's existing named-capability refusal. TestPipelinePromoteRefusesCapabilitySubsetAgreeingDigests measures the third case directly: a hand-built candidate declaring only 'healthz', bound to the real contract and docs digests, promoted via PromotionGate alone with a nil error before the fix; after the fix, VerifyCandidateAgainstContract (and therefore Pipeline.Promote) refuses it.

checks.name: A8-rollback-is-monotonic
checks.summary: Measured before: after promoting v1 then v2, a first Rollback moved stable to v1 (PreviousStableDigest=v2, Generation 5), and a second Rollback returned stable to v2 with a nil error at Generation 6. After the fix: Router.RollbackWithReason clears the forward pointer and records a RollbackRecord{repository,from,to,reason,at}; a second consecutive rollback is refused; moving forward again requires SetPreview plus a full Promote. TestBundleImmutableRouteAndRollback (unedited) still passes because it rolls back exactly once.

checks.name: A9-doc-set-resolvable-after-rollback
checks.summary: TestJourneyLocalSegment asserts that after a rollback the restored stable version's bundle is still resolvable in the Store, and ResolveChannel resolves to stable; TestResolveChannelDefaultsToPreviewWithoutStable asserts the default channel is preview when no stable release exists and stable otherwise.

checks.name: A10-retention-eligibility-three-refusals-and-positive-case
checks.summary: RetentionEligible is a pure function over an injected clock and a rollback window: TestRetentionEligibleThreeRefusalsAndPositiveCase asserts, with a separate case per condition, refusal when the digest is the current stable target, refusal when it is the previous stable target, refusal while the rollback window is open, refusal when a Requirement still references it, and eligibility only when none of those hold.

checks.name: A11-requirement-completion-chained-to-gate
checks.summary: A refused gate's zero StableReleaseProof makes domain.CompleteRequirementFromRelease refuse with ErrEvidenceIncomplete. A completed Requirement's StableSnapshot.BundleDigest/EvidenceDigest equal the bundle stored under the candidate id. After completion, Router.StableDigest equals the completed candidate digest and ResolveChannel is stable. A failed completion step (already-completed Requirement) leaves Router.Generation unchanged. V2-010's BFS already owns reachability-only-with-a-valid-proof; this test only chains a refused/accepted gate's output to that existing transition.

checks.name: A12-doc-routing-machine-checks
checks.summary: Over the real doc set (docs/preview/{README,capabilities,index,stable-diff}.md, docs/stable/index.md): TestDocSetLinksResolve measures 5 relative links (3 to foundation.json, 2 to capabilities.md) and confirms all resolve, including anchors. TestCapabilityAnchorBijectionBothDirections proves the anchor set in capabilities.md is bijective with the contract's 12 capability ids in both directions (document-to-contract is the new claim). TestReleaseMarkersOverRealDocSet confirms the preview marker equals the contract release 0.1.0-baseline and the stable marker is exactly 'none'. TestStableDiffHasRequiredSections confirms the four required sections. TestNoStableToPreviewLinksInRealDocSet confirms no stable-to-preview link. TestCodeBlockAllowlistRealDocSetIsEmptyToday measures 0 fenced blocks today; TestCodeBlockAllowlistOnSyntheticFixtureWithBlocks exercises the extractor and allowlist on a synthetic fixture that does contain blocks. No AI document review is used.

checks.name: A13-doc-edits-confined-and-marker-format-fixed
checks.summary: Documentation edits touched only docs/preview/index.md, docs/preview/stable-diff.md and docs/stable/index.md; docs/preview/capabilities.md and docs/preview/README.md are untouched (git diff confirms). The release marker is the fixed line format 'Release: <value>' / 'Stable release: <value>', parsed by ParseMarker, not free prose. No digest value appears in the doc set (only version strings and section text were added). make docs is green (git status --short confirms no other document changed).

checks.name: A14-journeys
checks.summary: TestJourneyReleaseSegment (Journey 1, release segment) and TestJourneyLocalSegment (Journey 7, local segment) are each a single top-level function with their own t.TempDir(), an injected control/permit and a context.WithTimeout deadline, no fixed sleep, no timer, no goroutine and no package-level mutable state. Journey 7's live half (intentionally breaking a deployed Preview and resuming against a real previous Stable) is V2-022 and is untouched here.

checks.name: A15-real-tree-conformance-not-promotable
checks.summary: AssembleFromRoot(repository root) resolves all seven roles (measured member counts: contract 3, schema 17, api-contract 1, implementation-manifest 4, migration 1, configuration 2, documentation 5, total 33 members), the documentation role resolves to exactly docs/preview/{README,capabilities,index,stable-diff}.md and docs/stable/index.md, and the contract compiles as release 0.1.0-baseline with the twelve baseline capability ids. The assembled candidate, with no fabricated evidence, is refused by CanPromote naming the first missing capability (cap-repository-registration), because every baseline capability carries empty evidence_ids in the real contract.

checks.name: A16-source-guard-boundaries
checks.summary: TestSourceGuardMatcherIsVerified checks the go/ast-based classifier against a known-positive (internal/ci, internal/update) and a known-negative (internal/domain, fmt) import path. TestSourceGuardNonTestFilesImportOnlyStdlibAndDomain parses the package's 4 non-test .go files (bundle.go, docs.go, pipeline.go, release.go) with go/parser/go/ast and asserts every import is standard library or internal/domain; it fails outright if zero files are scanned. TestSourceGuardNoFileImportsCIOrUpdate scans all 12 .go files in the package (including tests) and asserts none imports internal/ci or internal/update. internal/domain non-test files, contracts/**, ci/**, Makefile, go.mod, go.sum, devbox.json, devbox.lock, internal/application/**, internal/store/**, internal/api/** and internal/update/** are unchanged (git diff confirms); no new component was added to ci/components.json; test/journeys/ was not created (journeys live in internal/release/journey_test.go).

checks.name: A17-release-local-md-updated
checks.summary: docs/operations/release-local.md was rewritten to match the implementation: the seven bundle roles and digest framing; that the implementation identity at M5-local is the source manifest and not a built binary digest (V2-022, V2-034); the guarded/unguarded member partition, the UnguardedMembers allowlist and escalation E1 (a docs-only commit does not select the release component in selective CI, so the drift gate is enforced by make check, not by a docs-only CI run) and E4 (migration/configuration/future binary roles cannot be source-guarded at M5-local); that rollback is monotonic and route-level, that domain.ReleaseAssembling/ReleasePreviewDeployed/ReleaseRejected/ReleaseRollback are unreachable constants (escalation E3, a recorded divergence, not a decision this task made), and that route rollback is deliberately not coupled to internal/update.Switch's channel symlink rollback (documented, not imported); retention eligibility and its three refusals; and the fixpoint prohibition on digests in the doc set. It is the only document outside docs/preview and docs/stable this task edited. No TODO(ci) marker was introduced (component-docs stays green).

This record's evidence_key is the release key above. Exactly one entry, id ev-v2-021-release, is registered in .agents/v2/evidence/index.json with evidence_hash equal to the sha256 of this file's committed bytes.

checks.name: A19-make-check-green-after-evidence-commit
checks.summary: make check (environment format lint test contracts docs secrets ownership component-store-firestore workflow-pins) is green on the commit that added this evidence record and index entry, so gitleaks scans the committed history including these files. devbox run --pure -- make candidate-affected was then run: with no build/evidence present it reports 'missing evidence for release key ...'; after generating build/evidence entries for release and docs via make component COMPONENT=release and COMPONENT=docs, the docs component's evidence key (7318cd3f...) is confirmed to differ from the last recorded docs evidence key (399370809...), i.e. this task's document edits moved the docs component's key and require fresh docs evidence; task-ledger and other unrelated components also report as affected because of commits already on this branch before this task started, which this task did not create and does not resolve.

checks.name: A20-no-live-dogfood-claim
checks.summary: This task did not make the Foundation Repository a Preview target, did not deploy any Preview, did not exercise any capability in a Preview environment (all twelve baseline capabilities remain status preview with empty evidence_ids in the real contract), did not break a Preview or resume a Requirement on a real previous Stable, used no real Provider CLI, no GCP project and no credential, and no Stable release exists. Every candidate here is either a synthetic t.TempDir() tree or the real, non-promotable Foundation tree. 'このFoundation RepositoryをPreview対象にしてdogfoodする' and 'Previewを意図的に壊し、旧StableでRequirementを再開する' remain owned by V2-022.
